svg.text: euqalyptus docs · SDK reference / Remotes, Examples / Teleportation

div.p: Two nodes side-by-side (Alice on the left, Bob on the right). Each runs its own Qoala program. Show:

ul.li: On Alice's side: Remote("Bob") declaration, q = Entangle("Bob"), follow-up classical send/recv.
On Bob's side: Remote("Alice"), q = Entangle("Alice"), classical recv, etc.
A horizontal "EPR pair" arrow connecting the two Entangle calls — this is what the runtime turns into qnet.eprs (and later netqasm.eprs).
A separate horizontal "classical channel" arrow showing send_int/recv_int traffic.

div.p: This figure also serves the teleportation example pages — show the two correction bits flowing from Alice (sender) to Bob (receiver) over the classical channel.
